import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
CUT=pd.Timestamp('2033-01-19')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:CUT]
r=P.pct_change()
# Lagged medium-term trend quality: 60-session return, penalized by peak-to-trough drawdown and scaled by realized volatility.
ret60=P.pct_change(60)
peak=P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max()
dd=(P/peak-1).abs()
vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(60)
cons=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).apply(lambda x: np.mean(x>0),raw=True)
sig=(ret60/(vol+1e-12)/(1+2*dd))*(0.5+cons)
sig=sig.shift(1)
art='scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330120_drawdown_adjusted_trend_signal.csv'
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv(art,index=False)
for H in [5,10,20,30]:
 y=P.shift(-H)/P-1; vals=[]; ns=[]; dates=[]; turns=[]; prev=None
 for d in sig.index:
  q=pd.concat([sig.loc[d],y.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and q.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   vals.append(spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(q)); dates.append(d)
   if prev is not None:
    a=sig.loc[d].reindex(U); b=prev.reindex(U)
    turns.append(np.nanmean(np.abs((a-a.mean())/(a.abs().mean()+1e-12)-(b-b.mean())/(b.abs().mean()+1e-12))))
   prev=sig.loc[d]
 x=np.asarray(vals); print('H',H,'dates',len(x),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(np.nanmean(x),6),'ICIR',round(np.nanmean(x)/(np.nanstd(x,ddof=1)+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252),4),'hit',round(np.mean(x>0),4),'turn',round(np.nanmean(turns),4),'coverage',round(sig.notna().mean().mean(),4))
 for label,lo in [('2028','2028-01-01'),('recent','2031-10-01'),('last260','2032-01-01')]:
  zz=[v for d,v in zip(dates,vals) if d>=pd.Timestamp(lo)]; print(label,'n',len(zz),'IC',round(np.nanmean(zz),6) if zz else np.nan)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
series={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=4000)
    if d is not None and len(d)>300:
        d=d.copy(); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); d=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
        series[s]=d
# close-location pressure: recent return reversal strengthened when prior bars close near extremes
rows=[]
for s,d in series.items():
    c=d.close.astype(float); h=d.high.astype(float); l=d.low.astype(float)
    loc=((c-l)/(h-l).replace(0,np.nan)-0.5).rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean()
    r10=c.pct_change(10)
    vol=c.pct_change().rolling(30,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(10)
    # fade 10d move, with extra weight when recent closes consistently at an extreme
    raw=-r10*(1+1.5*loc.abs())/(vol+1e-8)
    rows.append(pd.DataFrame({'date':c.index,'symbol':s,'factor':raw.shift(1),'close':c}))
x=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True)
for h in [5,10,20,30]:
    z=x.sort_values(['symbol','date']); z['fwd']=z.groupby('symbol').close.shift(-h)/z.close-1
    vals=[]; turnover=[]; ns=[]
    for dt,g in z.groupby('date'):
        g=g.dropna(subset=['factor','fwd'])
        if len(g)>=8:
            vals.append(g.factor.corr(g.fwd,method='spearman')); ns.append(len(g))
        # signal rank turnover versus prior date, calculated on valid names
    ic=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); mean=ic.mean(); sd=ic.std(ddof=1)
    print(f'H{h} dates={len(ic)} avgN={np.mean(ns):.2f} IC={mean:.8f} ICIR_daily={mean/(sd+1e-12):.6f} annualized={mean/(sd+1e-12)*np.sqrt(252):.6f} hit={(ic>0).mean():.4f}')
# coverage and turnover as sign/rank change (daily available universe)
z=x.sort_values(['symbol','date']); z['valid']=z.factor.notna(); z['rank']=z.groupby('date').factor.rank(pct=True)
z['prev_rank']=z.groupby('symbol').rank.shift(1) if False else np.nan
print('dates',x.date.nunique(),'symbols',x.symbol.nunique(),'coverage',x.factor.notna().mean())
# rank turnover: mean absolute rank changes among consecutive rows per symbol
z['pr']=z.groupby('symbol').rank.transform(lambda q:q.shift(1)) if False else np.nan

import numpy as np, pandas as pd, glob, os
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
series={}
for s in U:
    fs=glob.glob('../persistent/index_data/'+s+'.csv')
    if not fs: continue
    d=pd.read_csv(fs[0]); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); d=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
    if len(d)>300: series[s]=d
rows=[]
for s,d in series.items():
    c=d.close.astype(float); h=d.high.astype(float); l=d.low.astype(float)
    loc=((c-l)/(h-l).replace(0,np.nan)-0.5).rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean()
    r10=c.pct_change(10); vol=c.pct_change().rolling(30,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(10)
    raw=-r10*(1+1.5*loc.abs())/(vol+1e-8)
    rows.append(pd.DataFrame({'date':c.index,'symbol':s,'factor':raw.shift(1),'close':c}))
x=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True)
for h in [5,10,20,30]:
    z=x.sort_values(['symbol','date']).copy(); z['fwd']=z.groupby('symbol').close.shift(-h)/z.close-1
    vals=[]; ns=[]
    for dt,g in z.groupby('date'):
        g=g.dropna(subset=['factor','fwd'])
        if len(g)>=8: vals.append(g.factor.corr(g.fwd,method='spearman')); ns.append(len(g))
    ic=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); mean=ic.mean(); sd=ic.std(ddof=1)
    print(f'H{h} dates={len(ic)} avgN={np.mean(ns):.2f} IC={mean:.8f} ICIR={mean/(sd+1e-12):.6f} hit={(ic>0).mean():.4f}')
z=x.sort_values(['symbol','date']).copy(); z['rank']=z.groupby('date').factor.rank(pct=True); z['rank_lag']=z.groupby('symbol')['rank'].shift(1)
print('dates',x.date.nunique(),'symbols',x.symbol.nunique(),'coverage',x.factor.notna().mean(),'turnover',((z['rank']-z['rank_lag']).abs().dropna()).mean())
z['fwd10']=z.groupby('symbol').close.shift(-10)/z.close-1; vv=[]
for dt,g in z.groupby('date'):
    if dt < z.date.max()-pd.Timedelta(days=400): continue
    g=g.dropna(subset=['factor','fwd10'])
    if len(g)>=8: vv.append(g.factor.corr(g.fwd10,method='spearman'))
q=pd.Series(vv).dropna(); print('recent400 dates',len(q),'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/(q.std(ddof=1)+1e-12))

   - Used lagged 10-session return reversal:
     \[
     -\frac{R_{10}}{\sigma_{30}\sqrt{10}}
     \times \left(1+1.5\left|\text{mean close-location}_{5}\right|\right)
     \]
   - Close location was calculated from each session’s position within its high-low range.

   - Evaluated across the 15 tradable benchmark instruments using available historical data.

Validation covered approximately 2020–2033, with 15 symbols available and an average daily cross-section of 11.87 instruments. Dates required at least 8 valid instruments.

### Current Effective Factors

The previously persisted effective factors remain the current effective miner-3 library, including:

- Rates-conditioned residual reversal
- Breadth-conditioned reversal

- Dispersion-conditioned reversal
- Macro-regime quality momentum

- Drawdown-adjusted reversal

Their incremental contribution and pairwise redundancy remain subject to deterministic artifact-level correlation auditing.

### Plans

- Test whether close-location conditioning adds value only during high-dispersion or specific macro regimes.
- Prioritize candidates with stronger recent-regime stability rather than accepting marginal full-sample IC.
- Continue monitoring the newly persisted drawdown-adjusted reversal factor for drift and library redundancy.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd, glob
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
rows=[]
for s in U:
 fs=glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv')
 if not fs: continue
 d=pd.read_csv(fs[0]); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); d=d.sort_values('date')
 if len(d)<350: continue
 c=d.close.astype(float); h=d.high.astype(float); l=d.low.astype(float)
 r=c.pct_change(); loc=((c-l)/(h-l).replace(0,np.nan)-.5)
 # Trend is rewarded only when recent closes consistently occupy the same side of their ranges.
 persistence=loc.rolling(10,min_periods=6).mean()
 trend=c.pct_change(30)
 vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(30)
 consistency=(r.gt(0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()-.5)*2
 f=(trend/(vol+1e-8))*persistence.abs().clip(0,1)*(0.5+0.5*consistency.abs())
 # direction retains trend sign, while range persistence scales conviction
 f=f*np.sign(trend)
 rows.append(pd.DataFrame({'date':d.date,'symbol':s,'factor':f.shift(1),'close':c}))
x=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True).sort_values(['symbol','date'])
for H in [5,10,20,30]:
 z=x.copy(); z['fwd']=z.groupby('symbol').close.shift(-H)/z.close-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for _,g in z.groupby('date'):
  g=g.dropna(subset=['factor','fwd'])
  if len(g)>=8:
   q=g.factor.corr(g.fwd,method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): vals.append(q); ns.append(len(g))
 q=pd.Series(vals); print(f'H{H} dates={len(q)} avgN={np.mean(ns):.2f} IC={q.mean():.8f} ICIR={q.mean()/(q.std(ddof=1)+1e-12):.6f} hit={(q>0).mean():.4f}')
print('symbols',x.symbol.nunique(),'dates',x.date.nunique(),'coverage',x.factor.notna().mean())
# lagged rank movement turnover
x['rank']=x.groupby('date').factor.rank(pct=True); x['prev']=x.groupby('symbol').rank.shift(1)
print('turnover', (x['rank']-x['prev']).abs().mean())
for n in [260,520,780]:
 q=x[x.date>=x.date.max()-pd.Timedelta(days=n)]
 vals=[]
 for _,g in q.groupby('date'):
  g=g.dropna(subset=['factor']); # forward recomputed at H10
  gg=x[(x.date==g.date.iloc[0])] if False else None
 print('recent_window_days',n)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd,glob
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; rows=[]
for s in U:
 fs=glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv')
 if not fs: continue
 d=pd.read_csv(fs[0]); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d.date); d=d.sort_values('date')
 if len(d)<350: continue
 c=d.close.astype(float); r=c.pct_change(); loc=((c-d.low)/(d.high-d.low).replace(0,np.nan)-.5)
 p=loc.rolling(15,min_periods=8).mean(); tr=c.pct_change(40); v=r.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(40)
 f=(tr/(v+1e-8))*p
 rows.append(pd.DataFrame({'date':d.date,'symbol':s,'factor':f.shift(1),'close':c}))
x=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True).sort_values(['symbol','date'])
for H in [5,10,20,30]:
 z=x.copy(); z['fwd']=z.groupby('symbol').close.shift(-H)/z.close-1; a=[];ns=[]
 for _,g in z.groupby('date'):
  g=g.dropna(subset=['factor','fwd'])
  if len(g)>=8:
   q=g.factor.corr(g.fwd,method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q):a.append(q);ns.append(len(g))
 q=pd.Series(a);print(f'H{H} dates={len(q)} avgN={np.mean(ns):.2f} IC={q.mean():.8f} ICIR={q.mean()/(q.std(ddof=1)+1e-12):.6f} hit={(q>0).mean():.4f}')
print('symbols',x.symbol.nunique(),'dates',x.date.nunique(),'coverage',x.factor.notna().mean());x['rank']=x.groupby('date')['factor'].rank(pct=True);x['pr']=x.groupby('symbol')['rank'].shift(1);print('turnover',(x['rank']-x.pr).abs().mean())

## Research Cycle Summary — 2033-02-17

### Explored Factors

1. **Range-position-weighted trend momentum**
   - 40-session price momentum normalized by 60-session volatility.
   - Scaled by the 15-session mean close position within each day’s high-low range.
   - One-session lag applied to all signals to avoid look-ahead bias.
   - Positive values represent momentum supported by consistently strong range closes; negative values represent weak momentum and lower-range closes.

2. **Range-position trend with consistency weighting**
   - Added a positive-return consistency modifier to the range-position trend signal.
   - H10 and H30 results were weaker than the simpler range-position formulation and it was not persisted.

### Validation Results

Validation used all 15 tradable benchmark instruments, with dates requiring at least 8 valid instruments.

| Factor | Horizon | Dates | Avg. N | IC | ICIR | Hit Ratio |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

|  | H20 | 4,090 | 11.87 | 0.02564 | 0.07502 | 52.64% |

- Absolute IC: **0.03548**, above **0.0070**

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'
xs={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'{base}/{a}.csv'
 if not os.path.exists(f): continue
 d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')
 c=d.close.astype(float); r=c.pct_change()
 # all ingredients shifted one day at signal construction
 mom=c.pct_change(60)
 vol=r.rolling(90,min_periods=45).std()*np.sqrt(60)
 loc=((c-d.low)/(d.high-d.low).replace(0,np.nan)).rolling(20,min_periods=10).mean()
 xs[a]=pd.DataFrame({'f':(mom/vol*loc).shift(1),'p':c})
# shared dates
F=pd.DataFrame({a:x.f for a,x in xs.items()}); P=pd.DataFrame({a:x.p for a,x in xs.items()})
res=[]; artifacts=[]
for h in [10,20,30,40]:
 ic=[]; rows=[]
 for dt in F.index:
  if dt not in P.index: continue
  f=F.loc[dt]; fr=P.shift(-h).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
  z=pd.concat([f,fr],axis=1).dropna(); n=len(z)
  if n>=8:
   v=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
   ic.append(v); rows.append((dt,n,v))
 s=pd.Series(ic); print('H',h,'dates',len(s),'avgN',np.mean([x[1] for x in rows]),'IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
 if h==30:
  for dt,n,v in rows: artifacts.append((dt,v))
# coverage and turnover based rank changes
valid=F.notna().sum(axis=1); print('coverage',valid.mean()/len(assets),'avg valid',valid.mean())
rank=F.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',rank.diff().abs().mean().mean())
out=pd.DataFrame(artifacts,columns=['date','ic']); out.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330317_range_responsive_trend_ic.csv',index=False)
# signal artifact full matrix for audit
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330317_range_responsive_trend_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; base='../persistent/stock_data'
R={}
for a in A:
 f=f'{base}/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); R[a]=d.close.pct_change()
r=pd.DataFrame(R); m=r.mean(axis=1); # residual to contemporaneous cross-sectional mean, all lagged
# 8-day residual reversal, volatility scaled, with 3-day return confirmation penalty
res=r.sub(m,axis=0)
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(8)
F=(-(res.rolling(8,min_periods=6).sum())/(vol+1e-9)).shift(1)
P=pd.DataFrame({a:pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{a}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for a in R})
for h in [5,10,20,30]:
 vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in F.index:
  if dt not in P.index: continue
  z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],(P.shift(-h).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1)],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(z))
 s=pd.Series(vals); print('H',h,'dates',len(s),'avgN',np.mean(ns),'IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330317_short_residual_reversal_signal.csv')

## Research Cycle Summary — 2033-03-17

### Explored Factors

1. **Range-responsive volatility-scaled trend**
   - 60-session momentum divided by 90-session realized volatility.
   - Multiplied by the 20-session average daily close-location ratio.
   - Signal lagged by one session to avoid look-ahead bias.
   - Raw signal exhibited a persistent negative cross-sectional relationship with forward returns; therefore, the persisted forecast direction is sign-inverted.

2. **Short residual reversal**
   - Eight-session asset return relative to the contemporaneous cross-asset average.
   - Volatility-scaled using 40-session realized volatility.
   - Lagged by one session.
   - The factor was weak at 5-, 10-, and 20-session horizons and did not meet admission gates.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | Dates | Avg. N | IC | ICIR | Hit Ratio | Status |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|

| Short residual reversal | H5 | 3,378 | 14.42 | -0.00768 | -0.02577 | 48.52% | Failed |

| Short residual reversal | H20 | 3,655 | 14.29 | -0.00587 | -0.01924 | 48.95% | Failed |
| Short residual reversal | H30 | 3,042 | 14.56 | 0.01042 | 0.03590 | 51.02% | Failed ICIR gate |

The new factor used the 30-session horizon for admission:

- Absolute IC: **0.07447**, above the 0.0070 threshold.
- Absolute ICIR: **0.19857**, above the 0.0840 threshold.
- Validation dates: **3,404**.
- Average cross-section: **9.46 instruments**.
- Universe: **15 tradable benchmark instruments**.
- Coverage: **57.37%**.
- Approximate rank turnover: **6.57%**.
- Library correlation: pending deterministic artifact-level audit.

The factor’s negative raw IC strengthened at longer horizons, supporting the sign inversion and slower holding-period interpretation.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and reload-verified:

- `factors/miner_3_20330317_range_responsive_trend_30d.json`

- Signal artifact: `scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330317_range_responsive_trend_signal.csv`

The signal artifact was updated to reflect the persisted sign-inverted direction.

The short residual reversal was not persisted because its ICIR failed the admission gate.

### Current Effective Factors

The latest miner-3 effective library includes the previously effective factors from prior cycles, including:

- Rates-conditioned residual reversal
- Breadth-conditioned reversal

- Dispersion-conditioned reversal
- Macro-regime quality momentum
- Volatility-scaled trend persistence
- Downside-quality momentum
- Drawdown-adjusted reversal
- Range-position-aligned momentum
- Slow range-position volatility-scaled trend

  - H30 IC: **0.07447**
  - H30 ICIR: **0.19857**
  - Coverage: **57.37%**
  - Turnover: **6.57%**

All pairwise library correlations remain subject to deterministic signal-artifact verification.

### Plans

- Revalidate the new factor over recent 260-, 520-, and 780-session windows.
- Compare artifact-level correlation with the existing range-aligned and slow range-trend factors.
- Test whether reducing the range-position window to 10–15 sessions improves recent responsiveness.
- Examine performance conditional on dispersion, volatility, and macro regimes.
- Monitor whether the sign-inverted relationship persists in the latest online regime.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; fs={}; ps={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'{base}/{a}.csv'
 if not os.path.exists(f): continue
 d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); c=d.close.astype(float); r=c.pct_change()
 mom=c.pct_change(60); vol=r.rolling(90,min_periods=45).std()*np.sqrt(60)
 loc=((c-d.low)/(d.high-d.low).replace(0,np.nan)).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
 fs[a]=(mom/vol*loc).shift(1); ps[a]=c
F=pd.DataFrame(fs); P=pd.DataFrame(ps); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],P.shift(-30).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
print('recent260',s.tail(260).mean(),s.tail(260).mean()/s.tail(260).std(),'recent520',s.tail(520).mean(),s.tail(520).mean()/s.tail(520).std(),'recent780',s.tail(780).mean(),s.tail(780).mean()/s.tail(780).std())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(assets),'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330331_range_responsive_shortloc_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330331_range_responsive_shortloc_signal.csv')

import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(base,s+'.csv'))
 d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); px[s]=d.set_index('date')['close']
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change()
# lagged 5-day reversal, volatility scaled, activated in low cross-sectional dispersion regimes
csdisp=R.rolling(20).std().mean(axis=1)
gate=(csdisp < csdisp.rolling(120).median()).astype(float)
vol=R.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(20)
f=(-R.rolling(5).sum()/vol)*gate.shift(1)
# ensure signal is only known at t, evaluate t+1 onward
for h in [5,10,20,30]:
 ic=[]; ns=[]; dates=[]
 fr=P.shift(-h)/P-1
 for dt in P.index:
  a=f.loc[dt]; b=fr.loc[dt]
  z=pd.concat([a,b],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   ic.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(z)); dates.append(dt)
 x=pd.Series(ic,index=pd.to_datetime(dates)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avgN',np.mean(ns),'IC',x.mean(),'ICIR',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(x>0),'recent260',x.tail(260).mean(),x.tail(260).mean()/x.tail(260).std(ddof=1))
# coverage and turnover among valid signal rankings
valid=f.notna(); print('coverage',valid.sum().sum()/(len(P)*len(U)))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',rank.diff().abs().mean().mean())
print('range',P.index.min(),P.index.max())

import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2033-04-14')
P={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d.date); P[s]=d.set_index('date').close
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:cutoff]; R=P.pct_change()
csdisp=R.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std().mean(axis=1,skipna=True)
gate=(csdisp < csdisp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).median()).astype(float)
vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()*np.sqrt(20)
f=(-R.rolling(5,min_periods=3).sum()/vol)*gate.shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,30]:
 ic=[]; ns=[]; dates=[]; fr=P.shift(-h)/P-1
 for dt in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   ic.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(z)); dates.append(dt)
 x=pd.Series(ic,index=pd.to_datetime(dates)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(x>0),4),'recent260',round(x.tail(260).mean(),6),round(x.tail(260).mean()/x.tail(260).std(ddof=1),6))
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/(len(P)*len(U)),4),'turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4),'range',P.index.min(),P.index.max())

import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2033-04-14')
P={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d.date); P[s]=d.set_index('date').close
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:cutoff]; R=P.pct_change()
csdisp=R.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std().mean(axis=1,skipna=True)
gate=(csdisp < csdisp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).median()).astype(float)
vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()*np.sqrt(20)
f=R.rolling(5,min_periods=3).sum().div(vol).mul(-1).mul(gate.shift(1),axis=0)
for h in [5,10,20,30]:
 ic=[]; ns=[]; dates=[]; fr=P.shift(-h)/P-1
 for dt in P.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   ic.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(z)); dates.append(dt)
 x=pd.Series(ic,index=pd.to_datetime(dates)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(x>0),4),'recent260',round(x.tail(260).mean(),6),round(x.tail(260).mean()/x.tail(260).std(ddof=1),6))
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum().sum()/(len(P)*len(U)),4),'turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4),'range',P.index.min(),P.index.max())

vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()*np.sqrt(20)

os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); f.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330414_dispersion_gated_short_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')
for h in [5,10,20,30]:

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; sig={}; px={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'{base}/{a}.csv'
 if not os.path.exists(f): continue
 d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')
 c=d.close.astype(float); h=d.high.astype(float); l=d.low.astype(float); r=c.pct_change()
 # Trend quality: 40d return, penalized by realized volatility, and confirmed by close location in 20d range.
 mom=c.pct_change(40); vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(40)
 hi=c.rolling(40,min_periods=25).max(); lo=c.rolling(40,min_periods=25).min()
 loc=((c-lo)/(hi-lo).replace(0,np.nan)).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
 # reward persistent upward range position, with volatility scaling
 sig[a]=(mom/vol*(0.5+loc)).shift(1); px[a]=c
F=pd.DataFrame(sig); P=pd.DataFrame(px); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),3),'IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),6))
for n in [260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),6))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(assets),6),'turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; fs={}; ps={}

 d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); c=d.close.astype(float); r=c.pct_change()

 loc=((c-d.low)/(d.high-d.low).replace(0,np.nan)).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
 fs[a]=(mom/vol*loc).shift(1); ps[a]=c
F=pd.DataFrame(fs); P=pd.DataFrame(ps); rows=[]

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; sig={}; px={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'{base}/{a}.csv'
 if not os.path.exists(f): continue
 d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); c=d.close.astype(float); r=c.pct_change()
 mom=c.pct_change(60); vol=r.rolling(120,min_periods=60).std()*np.sqrt(60)
 hi=c.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max(); lo=c.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min()
 loc=((c-lo)/(hi-lo).replace(0,np.nan)).rolling(15,min_periods=8).mean()
 # Inverse trend quality: favor persistent, high-range-position moves that historically mean-revert cross-sectionally.
 sig[a]=(-mom/vol*(0.5+loc)).shift(1); px[a]=c
F=pd.DataFrame(sig); P=pd.DataFrame(px); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),3),'IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),6))
for n in [260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),6))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(assets),6),'turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330512_long_range_quality_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330512_long_range_quality_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; sig={}; px={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'{base}/{a}.csv'
 if not os.path.exists(f): continue
 d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')
 c=d.close.astype(float); r=c.pct_change()
 # Contrarian signal: recent return, conditioned by smoothed location in its trailing range.
 # Extreme high locations receive stronger mean-reversion weight; volatility normalization avoids price-scale bias.
 mom=c.pct_change(20); vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(20)
 hi=c.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max(); lo=c.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min()
 loc=((c-lo)/(hi-lo).replace(0,np.nan)).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
 sig[a]=(-mom/vol*(0.5+loc)).shift(1); px[a]=c
F=pd.DataFrame(sig); P=pd.DataFrame(px); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),3),'IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),6))
for n in [260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),6))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(assets),6),'turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330526_range_position_reversal_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330526_range_position_reversal_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; base='../persistent/stock_data'; S={}; P={}
for a in A:
 f=f'{base}/{a}.csv'
 if not os.path.exists(f): continue
 d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); c=d.close.astype(float); r=c.pct_change()
 mom=c.pct_change(5); vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(5)
 hi=c.rolling(40,min_periods=25).max(); lo=c.rolling(40,min_periods=25).min(); loc=((c-lo)/(hi-lo).replace(0,np.nan)).rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean()
 S[a]=(-mom/vol*(0.5+loc)).shift(1); P[a]=c
F=pd.DataFrame(S); Q=pd.DataFrame(P); out=[]
for dt in F.index:
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],Q.shift(-10).loc[dt]/Q.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: out.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),3),'IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),6))
for n in [260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),6))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),6),'turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330526_short_range_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330526_short_range_reversal_signal.csv')

{"read_file": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; sig={}; px={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'{base}/{a}.csv'
 if not os.path.exists(f): continue
 d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); c=d.close.astype(float); r=c.pct_change()
 mom=c.pct_change(60); vol=r.rolling(120,min_periods=60).std()*np.sqrt(60)
 hi=c.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max(); lo=c.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min()
 loc=((c-lo)/(hi-lo).replace(0,np.nan)).rolling(15,min_periods=8).mean()
 # Inverse trend quality: favor persistent, high-range-position moves that historically mean-revert cross-sectionally.
 sig[a]=(-mom/vol*(0.5+loc)).shift(1); px[a]=c
F=pd.DataFrame(sig); P=pd.DataFrame(px); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),3),'IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),6))
for n in [260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),6))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(assets),6),'turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330512_long_range_quality_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330512_long_range_quality_signal.csv')
"}

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; sig={}; px={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'{base}/{a}.csv'
 if not os.path.exists(f): continue
 d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); c=d.close.astype(float); r=c.pct_change()
 mom=c.pct_change(20); vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(20)
 hi=c.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max(); lo=c.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min()
 loc=((c-lo)/(hi-lo).replace(0,np.nan)).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
 down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(40,min_periods=20).std(); asym=(down/vol.replace(0,np.nan)).clip(0.25,2.5)
 # Mean reversion is amplified when recent downside risk is unusually large, with range-location conditioning.
 sig[a]=(-mom/vol*(0.5+loc)*asym).shift(1); px[a]=c
F=pd.DataFrame(sig); P=pd.DataFrame(px); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('candidate downside_asymmetry_range_reversal_10d')
print('dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),3),'IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),6))
for n in [260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(n,len(s))); print('recent',len(q),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),6))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(assets),6),'turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330609_downside_asymmetry_range_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330609_downside_asymmetry_range_reversal_signal.csv')

### Explored Factors

- **Downside-asymmetry range reversal**
  - Signal: lagged 20-day return reversal, volatility-scaled and conditioned on trailing 60-day range position; amplified by downside-volatility asymmetry.
  - Validation across the 15 tradable instruments and 10-trading-day forward returns.
  - The resulting signal was numerically identical to the existing range-position reversal under the available data because the asymmetry adjustment did not materially vary.

- **Volatility-shock range-position reversal**
  - Signal: existing volatility-scaled range-position reversal multiplied by a clipped ratio of 10-day realized volatility to its 60-day baseline.
  - Motivation: amplify reversal signals during short-term volatility shocks while retaining range-location conditioning.
  - Used lagged inputs to avoid look-ahead bias.

  - `scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330609_volshock_range_reversal_ic.csv`
- No new effective factor was admitted this cycle.

  - Last validated: 2033-05-26
  - Recent 260-day ICIR: 0.096406
  - Recent 520-day ICIR: 0.180379

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; prices={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'{base}/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')
  prices[a]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(prices).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change()
# Orthogonal defensive-leadership rotation: short horizon relative strength,
# signed by lagged breadth of defensive assets versus cyclicals. All inputs lagged.
short=P.pct_change(20); long=P.pct_change(60)
defs=['XAU','US10Y','CN10Y']; cyc=['WTI','COPPER','BTC','ETH','SOX','NDX']
lead=(short[defs].mean(axis=1)-short[cyc].mean(axis=1)).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
# asset-specific signal: 20d-vs-60d acceleration, with a common regime multiplier
acc=(short-long).shift(1)
gate=(lead.rolling(40,min_periods=20).rank(pct=True)-0.5).shift(1)
F=acc.mul(1+0.8*gate,axis=0)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 fut=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fut],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'assets',len(P.columns),'IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
for n in [260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(n); print('recent',n,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(assets),'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330623_defensive_leadership_rotation_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330623_defensive_leadership_rotation_signal.csv')

{"read_file": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'; fs={}; ps={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'{base}/{a}.csv'
 if not os.path.exists(f): continue
 d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); c=d.close.astype(float); r=c.pct_change()
 mom=c.pct_change(60); vol=r.rolling(90,min_periods=45).std()*np.sqrt(60)
 loc=((c-d.low)/(d.high-d.low).replace(0,np.nan)).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
 fs[a]=(mom/vol*loc).shift(1); ps[a]=c
F=pd.DataFrame(fs); P=pd.DataFrame(ps); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],P.shift(-30).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); P[a]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change(); nA=len(P.columns)
# Candidate: volatility-scaled medium-term trend, conditioned by lagged defensive breadth.
# Breadth is deliberately a regime state, not a future-dependent trade filter.
defs=[x for x in ['XAU','US10Y','CN10Y'] if x in P]; cyc=[x for x in ['WTI','COPPER','BTC','ETH','SOX','NDX'] if x in P]
trend=P.pct_change(20); vol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(20)
base=(trend/vol).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
db=(R[defs].rolling(20,min_periods=10).sum().gt(0).mean(axis=1)-R[cyc].rolling(20,min_periods=10).sum().gt(0).mean(axis=1))
# smooth and lag; multiplier remains positive and bounded
reg=(1+0.8*db.rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()).clip(.35,1.65).shift(1)
F=base.shift(1).mul(reg,axis=0)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 fut=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fut],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'assets',nA)
print('IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
for k in [260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/nA,'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330707_defensive_breadth_voltrend_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330707_defensive_breadth_voltrend_signal.csv')

  prices[a]=d.close.astype(float)

defs=['XAU','US10Y','CN10Y']; cyc=['WTI','COPPER','BTC','ETH','SOX','NDX']

gate=(lead.rolling(40,min_periods=20).rank(pct=True)-0.5).shift(1)
F=acc.mul(1+0.8*gate,axis=0)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:

 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fut],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))

os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330623_defensive_leadership_rotation_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330623_defensive_leadership_rotation_signal.csv')

### Explored Factors

1. **Defensive-Breadth Volatility-Scaled Trend**
   - 20-day asset momentum divided by 40-day volatility.
   - Scaled by lagged defensive-versus-cyclical breadth:
     - Defensive: `XAU`, `US10Y`, `CN10Y`
     - Cyclical: `WTI`, `COPPER`, `BTC`, `ETH`, `SOX`, `NDX`
   - All inputs were lagged to avoid look-ahead bias.

2. **Defensive-Breadth Residual Reversal**
   - Negative 10-day cross-sectional residual return divided by 30-day volatility.
   - Magnitude conditioned on lagged defensive breadth.
   - Evaluated over the full 15-asset tradable universe.

3. **Defensive-Conditioned Relative Momentum**
   - Lagged 30-day asset momentum multiplied by a bounded defensive-versus-cyclical leadership regime multiplier.
   - Designed to test whether defensive leadership improves medium-term trend selection.

### Validation Results

Validation cutoff: **2033-07-07**  
Forward horizon: **10 trading days**  
Universe: **15 assets**  
All usable IC dates met the minimum 8-instrument requirement.

| Factor | Dates | Avg. valid instruments | Daily IC | Daily ICIR | Recent 260d ICIR | Recent 520d ICIR | Coverage | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Defensive-breadth volatility-scaled trend | 2,392 | 12.24 | -0.008461 | -0.026031 | -0.038310 | -0.072749 | 64.60% | 9.48% | Failed |
| Defensive-breadth residual reversal | 2,379 | 14.28 | -0.006578 | -0.022266 | -0.268084 | -0.127989 | 67.37% | 11.93% | Failed |
| Defensive-conditioned relative momentum | 2,121 | 14.74 | -0.034358 | -0.108016 | -0.088198 | -0.074719 | 69.53% | 7.57% | Failed |

Admission thresholds:

- Absolute daily IC ≥ **0.0070**
- Absolute daily ICIR ≥ **0.0840**

None of the candidates passed both gates. The relative-momentum candidate had a sufficiently large absolute ICIR in the full sample, but its IC was negative and therefore did not satisfy the required positive/negative admission interpretation as a usable factor without explicit directional inversion and further validation. Its recent performance was also persistently negative.

### Persistence Actions

- No factors were persisted.
- Signal and IC artifacts were generated for audit under:
  - `scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330707_defensive_breadth_voltrend_*`
  - `scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330707_defensive_breadth_reversal_*`
  - `scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330707_defensive_relative_momentum_*`
- No live account, backtest, step, date, or account files were modified.

### Current Effective Factors

The previously persisted factor remains the latest effective discovery from this agent:

- `miner_3_20330623_defensive_leadership_rotation_10d`
  - Daily IC: **0.050009**
  - Daily ICIR: **0.157651**
  - Recent 260-day ICIR: **0.339121**
  - Coverage: **66.61%**
  - Turnover: **6.31%**
  - Last validated: **2033-06-23**

Previously effective library factors, including `miner_3_range_position_reversal_10d`, remain unchanged.

### Plans

- Avoid persisting the tested breadth-conditioned trend and reversal variants due to weak or negative recent predictive power.
- Investigate orthogonal factors based on:
  - cross-asset volatility compression and expansion,
  - downside-versus-upside asymmetry,
  - defensive leadership breadth changes rather than static breadth levels,
  - residual momentum after removing common equity and macro components.
- Continue monitoring the recent strength and library correlation of the defensive leadership rotation factor.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); P[a]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-07-15']
R=P.pct_change(); eq=[x for x in ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX'] if x in P]
# Residualize each asset's 30d return against the lagged equal-weight equity benchmark return.
eqret=R[eq].mean(axis=1)
asset30=P.pct_change(30); common30=eqret.rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum()
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(eqret).div(eqret.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
F=(asset30-beta.mul(common30,axis=0)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 fut=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fut],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
for k in [260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330721_residual_momentum_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330721_residual_momentum_signal.csv')

from scipy.stats import spearmanr

P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-07-15']; R=P.pct_change()

rev=-P.pct_change(5)
disp=R.rolling(20,min_periods=12).std().mean(axis=1)

for k in [260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); P[a]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-07-15']; R=P.pct_change()
# Trend quality: 30d return discounted by downside volatility, with lagged inputs.
ret=P.pct_change(30); down=R.clip(upper=0).rolling(40,min_periods=20).std(); up=R.clip(lower=0).rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()
F=(ret/(down*np.sqrt(30)+1e-8)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 fut=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fut],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
for k in [260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); P[a]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-08-03']
R=P.pct_change(); common=R.mean(axis=1)
# Broad common-risk residual: 30d asset return less rolling beta to equal-weight all tradables times common return.
common30=common.rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum()
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(common).div(common.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); P[a]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-08-17']
R=P.pct_change(); mkt=R.mean(axis=1)
m30=mkt.rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum()
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(mkt).div(mkt.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
res=P.pct_change(30)-beta.mul(m30,axis=0)
vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Lagged inverse-vol weighted contrarian residual: favor recent underperformers, but discount noisy assets.
F=(-res/vol).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}; V={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')
  P[a]=d.close.astype(float)
  if 'volume' in d: V[a]=d.volume.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-08-31']; V=pd.DataFrame(V).reindex(P.index).reindex(columns=P.columns)
R=P.pct_change(); mkt=R.mean(axis=1)
m30=mkt.rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum()
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(mkt).div(mkt.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
res=P.pct_change(30)-beta.mul(m30,axis=0)
vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Relative volume shock, lagged. Contrarian residual is strengthened when the move occurred on unusual volume.
rv=V/V.rolling(40,min_periods=20).mean()
F=((-res/vol)*(1+0.5*np.log(rv.clip(lower=0.25,upper=4)))).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 fut=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fut],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330901_volume_confirmed_residual_reversal_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330901_volume_confirmed_residual_reversal_signal.csv')

{"read_file": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); P[a]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-08-17']
R=P.pct_change(); mkt=R.mean(axis=1)
m30=mkt.rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum()
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(mkt).div(mkt.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
res=P.pct_change(30)-beta.mul(m30,axis=0)
vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Lagged inverse-vol weighted contrarian residual: favor recent underperformers, but discount noisy assets.
F=(-res/vol).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 fut=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fut],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330818_volscaled_residual_reversal_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330818_volscaled_residual_reversal_signal.csv')
"}

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')
  P[a]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-09-14']
R=P.pct_change(); mkt=R.mean(axis=1)
# Trend strength is residualized from common market movement, then conditioned on broad cross-asset participation.
ret20=P.pct_change(20); vol30=R.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
breadth=ret20.gt(0).mean(axis=1)
# smooth breadth and use only lagged information; neutral around 50%, amplify agreement, suppress mixed regimes
bg=(breadth.rolling(10,min_periods=8).mean()-0.5)*2
F=(ret20/vol30).mul((1+0.7*bg),axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 fut=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fut],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330915_breadth_gated_trend_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330915_breadth_gated_trend_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date'); P[a]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-09-14']; R=P.pct_change()
# Intermediate horizon momentum, volatility managed and lagged. Exclude the most recent 5 days.
r60=P.pct_change(60); r5=P.pct_change(5); vol40=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
F=((r60-r5)/vol40).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 fut=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fut],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330915_volscaled_intermediate_momentum_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330915_volscaled_intermediate_momentum_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}; V={}
for a in assets:
 f=f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f):
  d=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')
  P[a]=d.close.astype(float)
  if 'volume' in d: V[a]=d.volume.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-09-28']
V=pd.DataFrame(V).reindex(P.index).reindex(columns=P.columns)
R=P.pct_change()
# Contrarian 60-day move excluding the latest 5 sessions, volatility scaled.
raw=(P.pct_change(60)-P.pct_change(5))
vol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
base=-raw/vol
# Unusual relative volume confirms that the intermediate move was sentiment-driven.
rv=V/V.rolling(40,min_periods=25).mean()
F=(base*(1+0.35*np.log(rv.clip(lower=0.25,upper=4)))).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 fut=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fut],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330929_volume_confirmed_intermediate_reversal_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330929_volume_confirmed_intermediate_reversal_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; P={}
for a in A:
 f='../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f): P[a]=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-09-28']; R=P.pct_change(); vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# short-term contrarian return, volatility scaled; emphasize cross-asset disagreement regimes
cross=R.rolling(10,min_periods=8).std(axis=1)
scale=(cross/cross.rolling(60,min_periods=30).median()).clip(.5,2)
F=((-P.pct_change(10)/vol)*scale).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],(P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1)],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',r.n.mean(),'assets',len(P.columns));print('IC',s.mean(),'ICIR',s.mean()/s.std(),'hit',(s>0).mean())
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std())
print('coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),'turnover',F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True);r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330929_dispersion_gated_reversal_ic.csv',index=False);F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20330929_dispersion_gated_reversal_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index()
 px[s]=d
p=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index()
# signal available at t: 30d lagged return divided by lagged 20d realized vol
ret=p.pct_change()
sig=p.shift(1).pct_change(30) / (ret.shift(1).rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(20))
# forward return from t close to t+10 close
fwd=p.shift(-10)/p-1
rows=[]
for dt in sig.index:
 z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).set_index('date')
for end in ['2033-10-12','2032-10-12','2031-10-12']:
 x=r.loc[:end]
 if len(x): print(end,'dates',len(x),'avgN',x.n.mean(),'IC',x.ic.mean(),'ICIR',x.ic.mean()/x.ic.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x.ic>0).mean())
print('coverage',sig.loc[:'2033-10-12'].notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15)
# rank turnover
q=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); common=q.index.intersection(q.index.to_series().shift(1).dropna().index)
print('turnover',((q.loc[common]-q.shift(1).loc[common]).abs().mean(axis=1)).mean())
print('horizons')
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 ff=p.shift(-h)/p-1; rr=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],ff.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rr.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 rr=np.array(rr); print(h,len(rr),np.nanmean(rr),np.nanmean(rr)/np.nanstd(rr,ddof=1))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for a in A:
 f='../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f): P[a]=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-10-26']
R=P.pct_change(); m=R.mean(axis=1)
# residual cumulative return versus contemporaneous equal-weight benchmark, all lagged before scoring
asset20=P.pct_change(20); bench20=m.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()
resid=asset20.sub(bench20,axis=0)
vol=R.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
F=(-resid.div(vol)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'dates',len(q))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20331027_crossasset_residual_reversal_20d_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20331027_crossasset_residual_reversal_20d_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for a in A:
 f='../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f): P[a]=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-12-15']
R=P.pct_change()
# Low downside participation: negative ratio of downside deviation to total volatility.
down=R.clip(upper=0).rolling(60,min_periods=35).std()
tot=R.rolling(60,min_periods=35).std()
F=(-down.div(tot.replace(0,np.nan))).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20331222_downside_participation_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20331222_downside_participation_signal.csv')

## Research Cycle Summary — miner_3 — 2033-12-22

### Explored Factors

1. **Downside participation quality**
   - Signal: negative rolling 60-day downside volatility divided by total 60-day volatility.
   - Intended interpretation: favor assets with lower downside participation and more favorable return asymmetry.
   - Shifted by one completed trading day; evaluated against 10-trading-day forward returns.

2. **Volatility-scaled short-term reversal**
   - Signal: `-10-day return / 20-day annualized realized volatility`.
   - Shifted by one day to prevent look-ahead bias.
   - Evaluated against 10-trading-day forward returns.

3. **Volatility-scaled intermediate momentum**
   - Signal: `60-day return / 60-day annualized realized volatility`.
   - Shifted by one day and evaluated against 10-trading-day forward returns.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Dates | Avg. instruments | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Coverage | Rank turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Downside participation quality | 1,979 | 12.18 | **-0.038464** | **-0.130555** | 0.4376 | 50.45% | 4.87% | Failed |
| Vol-scaled short-term reversal | 1,917 | 12.69 | 0.017925 | 0.058624 | 0.5060 | 45.03% | 10.66% | Failed |
| Vol-scaled 60D momentum | 1,907 | 12.25 | **-0.072383** | **-0.250825** | 0.3917 | 46.45% | 5.88% | Failed |

Validation periods ended on 2033-12-01 because a complete 10-trading-day forward-return horizon was required. Each test used the 15-asset tradable universe, with at least eight valid instruments per IC observation.

#### Rolling behavior

- **Downside participation quality**
  - Recent 120 observations: IC 0.026901, ICIR 0.102130
  - Recent 260 observations: IC -0.045290, ICIR -0.184624
  - Recent 520 observations: IC -0.037233, ICIR -0.128402
  - Recent 780 observations: IC -0.033126, ICIR -0.116099

- **Vol-scaled short-term reversal**
  - Recent 120 observations: IC -0.002164, ICIR -0.006494
  - Recent 260 observations: IC -0.034575, ICIR -0.112154
  - Recent 520 observations: IC -0.006964, ICIR -0.021148
  - Recent 780 observations: IC 0.007665, ICIR 0.023942

- **Vol-scaled 60D momentum**
  - Recent 120 observations: IC -0.017895, ICIR -0.068993
  - Recent 260 observations: IC -0.024265, ICIR -0.098211
  - Recent 520 observations: IC -0.074912, ICIR -0.247336
  - Recent 780 observations: IC -0.058587, ICIR -0.203205

The benchmark admission thresholds are absolute IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute ICIR ≥ 0.0840. Although the 60D momentum candidate exceeds the thresholds in absolute magnitude, its consistently negative predictive direction is not suitable for admission as a momentum factor. The reversal interpretation would require a separately specified and validated factor rather than silently reversing the candidate.

### Persistence Actions

No factors were persisted. None of the candidates provided a sufficiently robust, interpretable factor in its proposed direction:

- Downside participation quality failed both the full-sample IC and ICIR gates.
- Short-term reversal passed the absolute IC threshold but failed the ICIR threshold and recent stability checks.
- 60D momentum was strongly and persistently negative, indicating momentum failure in this universe and regime rather than a validated positive momentum effect.

Signal and IC artifacts were generated under:

- `scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20331222_downside_participation_signal.csv`
- `scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20331222_downside_participation_ic.csv`
- `scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20331222_volscaled_short_reversal_signal.csv`
- `scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20331222_volscaled_short_reversal_ic.csv`
- `scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20331222_volscaled_momentum_60d_signal.csv`
- `scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20331222_volscaled_momentum_60d_ic.csv`

### Current Effective Factors

The previously persisted **volatility-scaled long-horizon reversal 240D** remains the latest miner_3 effective addition:

- IC: 0.090932
- ICIR: 0.302874
- Coverage: 46.72%
- Rank turnover: 4.39%
- Validated: 2033-12-08

The 90D, 120D, and 180D long-horizon volatility-scaled reversal variants also remain effective according to their persisted records, subject to correlation auditing and scheduled revalidation. Their high conceptual similarity warrants capped ensemble exposure.

### Plans

- Test a sign-reversed, explicitly named **volatility-scaled 60D contrarian reversal** only if it can be validated independently without treating the failed momentum formulation as admitted.
- Explore drawdown recovery and distance-from-trough factors, which may offer more orthogonal information than additional long-horizon reversal variants.
- Investigate regime-conditioned downside participation, especially conditioning on cross-asset dispersion or market breadth.
- Continue pairwise correlation and incremental-value analysis against the existing 90D–240D reversal family before recommending further persistence.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for a in A:
 f='../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f): P[a]=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2033-12-20']; R=P.pct_change(); vol=R.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Recovery from 120d trough, scaled by realized volatility; lagged one day.
F=(P/P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).min()-1).div(vol).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340105_drawdown_recovery_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340105_drawdown_recovery_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; P={}
for a in A:
 f='../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f): P[a]=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-01-25']; R=P.pct_change(); vol=R.rolling(60,min_periods=35).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# risk-adjusted medium momentum, rewarded when daily direction is consistent
mom=P.pct_change(60).div(vol); consistency=R.rolling(60,min_periods=35).apply(lambda x: (x>0).mean(),raw=True)-.5
F=(mom*consistency).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340202_consistent_momentum_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340202_consistent_momentum_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; P={}
for a in A:
 f='../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv'
 if os.path.exists(f): P[a]=pd.read_csv(f,parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-02-08']; R=P.pct_change()
vol=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
mom=P.pct_change(120).div(vol)
cons=R.rolling(120,min_periods=75).apply(lambda x:(x>0).mean(),raw=True)-.5
F=(mom*cons).shift(1)
rows=[]

 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-03-08']; R=P.pct_change(); vol=R.rolling(60,min_periods=35).std()*np.sqrt(252)
F=(-P.pct_change(180).div(vol)).shift(1); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340316_reversal180_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340316_reversal180_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-03-22']; R=P.pct_change(); vol=R.rolling(60,min_periods=35).std()*np.sqrt(252)
F=(-P.pct_change(180).div(vol)).shift(1); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-04-05']; R=P.pct_change()
# Trend quality: 20d return, scaled by realized risk and path efficiency; lagged one day
vol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
eff=P.diff(20).abs().div(R.abs().rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum())
F=(P.pct_change(20).div(vol)*eff).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340413_efficiency_momentum_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340413_efficiency_momentum_signal.csv')
