import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-04-05']; R=P.pct_change(); v20=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); v60=R.rolling(60,min_periods=35).std()
# Low current volatility relative to own medium-term baseline, lagged; cross-sectional rank signal
F=(-(v20/v60)).shift(1); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340413_lowvol_regime_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340413_lowvol_regime_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-04-05']; R=P.pct_change(); v=R.rolling(60,min_periods=35).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Reversal of medium-term drawdown, rewarding assets that recovered from their 120d trough, risk scaled
rollmax=P.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max(); dd=P/rollmax-1
F=(-dd.div(v)).shift(1); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(k); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340413_drawdown_recovery_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340413_drawdown_recovery_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-04-19']; R=P.pct_change()
# Relative-strength reversal: deviation of each asset's 20d return from contemporaneous cross-sectional median,
# scaled by its 40d volatility; negative deviations are expected to mean-revert over the next 10 trading days.
r20=P.pct_change(20); med=r20.median(axis=1); vol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
F=(-(r20.sub(med,axis=0)).div(vol)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340427_relative_strength_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340427_relative_strength_reversal_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-05-02']; R=P.pct_change()
vix=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].astype(float).reindex(P.index).ffill()
r20=P.pct_change(20); med=r20.median(axis=1); vol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Stress-conditioned relative reversal: reversal is amplified when VIX is elevated versus its 60d history.
vz=(vix-vix.rolling(60,min_periods=30).mean())/vix.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()
stress=(1+0.50*vz.clip(-1.5,1.5)).clip(0.25,1.75)
F=(-(r20.sub(med,axis=0)).div(vol)).mul(stress,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; z=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340511_vix_conditioned_relative_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340511_vix_conditioned_relative_reversal_signal.csv')

z=(vix-vix.rolling(60,min_periods=30).mean())/vix.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std(); stress=(z>0).astype(float)
r20=P.pct_change(20); med=r20.median(axis=1); vol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}; P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-05-02']; R=P.pct_change()
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].astype(float).reindex(P.index).ffill().pct_change()
# Asset-specific rolling VIX beta; penalize VIX-sensitive names in reversal score, using only lagged data.
beta=R.rolling(120,min_periods=60).cov(v).div(v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).var(),axis=0)
beta_z=beta.sub(beta.mean(axis=1),axis=0).div(beta.std(axis=1),axis=0).clip(-2,2)
r20=P.pct_change(20); med=r20.median(axis=1); vol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(252)
F=(-(r20.sub(med,axis=0)).div(vol) * (1-0.25*beta_z)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(P.columns))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(P.columns),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340511_vix_beta_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340511_vix_beta_reversal_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-05-24']; R=P.pct_change()
# Downside asymmetry quality: downside semideviation relative to total volatility,
# with a trend-quality adjustment. All inputs are lagged before forward testing.
vol=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
down=R.where(R<0).rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
# lower downside share is favorable; modestly reward positive consistency
asym=-(down/vol)
cons=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean()/vol
F=(asym+0.25*cons).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340525_downside_asymmetry_quality_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340525_downside_asymmetry_quality_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-05-24']; R=P.pct_change()
vol=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
# downside semideviation uses available negative observations, avoiding survivorship/lookahead
neg=R.clip(upper=0)
down=np.sqrt((neg**2).rolling(60,min_periods=20).mean())
asym=-(down/vol)
cons=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean()/vol
F=(asym+0.25*cons).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340525_downside_asymmetry_quality_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340525_downside_asymmetry_quality_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-05-24']; R=P.pct_change()
# Cross-asset lead-lag: leave-one-out average of other assets' recent 5d return,
# volatility normalized cross-sectional leader signal; lagged before 10d forward test.
r5=R.rolling(5,min_periods=4).sum(); ownvol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()
F=pd.DataFrame(index=P.index,columns=A,dtype=float)
for a in A:
 others=r5.drop(columns=a).mean(axis=1)
 F[a]=(others/ownvol[a]).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min(),r.date.max(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340525_cross_asset_leadlag_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340525_cross_asset_leadlag_signal.csv')

   - Construction: negative downside semideviation relative to total volatility over 60 days, combined with a 60-day return-consistency term:

     F = -\frac{\text{downside semideviation}_{60}}{\text{volatility}_{60}}
       + 0.25\frac{\text{return mean}_{60}}{\text{volatility}_{60}}
     \]
   - The signal was lagged by one day before evaluating 10-trading-day forward returns.
   - Motivation: favor assets with lower downside-risk asymmetry and more consistent returns.

2. **Cross-asset lead-lag**
   - Construction: each asset’s score was the five-day return of the other 14 assets, averaged cross-sectionally and normalized by the asset’s 40-day volatility.
   - Motivation: test whether recent aggregate cross-asset leadership predicts subsequent asset performance.

### Validation Results

Validation date: **2034-05-25**

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
    x=get_index_daily_data(s, days=3600)
    if x is not None and len(x):
        x=x.copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x['date']); x=x.set_index('date').sort_index(); D[s]=x['close'].astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill()
r=P.pct_change()
# medium trend quality: risk-adjusted 60d return times path efficiency, all lagged by one day
ret=P/P.shift(60)-1
vol=r.rolling(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
eff=ret.abs()/(r.abs().rolling(60).sum()+1e-12)
f=(ret/(vol+1e-12))*eff
# evaluate dates with at least 8 assets and 10d forward return
rows=[]
for i in range(1,len(P)-10):
    dt=P.index[i]
    vals=f.iloc[i-1]; fw=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1
    z=pd.concat([vals.rename('f'),fw.rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8:
        ic=z.f.corr(z.y, method='spearman'); rows.append((dt,ic,len(z)))
a=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
for n in [120,260,520,780,1200, len(a)]:
 b=a.tail(n); mu=b.ic.mean(); sd=b.ic.std(ddof=1); print(n, 'dates',len(b),'avg_n',round(b.n.mean(),2),'IC',round(mu,6),'ICIR',round(mu/sd*np.sqrt(1) if sd else 0,6),'hit',round((b.ic>0).mean(),4))
# turnover and coverage by cross-sectional rank changes
valid=f.notna().sum(axis=1)/15
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()
print('TOTAL_DATES',len(a),'period',a.index.min(),a.index.max(),'coverage',round(valid.mean(),4),'turnover',round(turn,4))
# decade/regime slices
for start,end in [('2020','2023'),('2023','2027'),('2027','2031'),('2031','2034')]:
 b=a.loc[start:end]; print('REGIME',start,end,len(b),round(b.ic.mean(),6),round(b.ic.mean()/b.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(b)>2 else None)
# artifacts signal, IC
f.loc[a.index].to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340608_trend_quality_signal.csv')
a.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340608_trend_quality_ic.csv')

### Explored Factors

1. **Medium-horizon trend quality**
   - Construction: 60-day return divided by annualized 60-day volatility, multiplied by a 60-day path-efficiency measure:
     \[
     F=\frac{R_{60}}{\sigma_{60}}\times
     \frac{|R_{60}|}{\sum_{t=1}^{60}|r_t|}
     \]
   - Signal lagged by one completed session and evaluated against 10-trading-day forward returns.
   - Motivation: identify persistent, efficient trends while reducing exposure to noisy price paths.

2. **20-day low volatility**
   - Construction:
     \[
     F=-\operatorname{StdDev}_{20}(\Delta\log P)
     \]
   - Signal lagged by one completed session and evaluated against 10-trading-day forward returns.
   - Motivation: test whether lower recent realized volatility predicts stronger risk-adjusted subsequent performance and provides a defensive complement to reversal factors.

### Validation Results

Validation date: **2034-06-08**

| Factor | Dates | Avg. instruments | IC | ICIR | Coverage | Turnover | Result |

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change()
# Defensive downside asymmetry: assets with smaller downside semideviation relative to total volatility,
# mildly rewarded for stable positive average returns. Lagged one session.
vol=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
down=np.sqrt((R.clip(upper=0)**2).rolling(60,min_periods=20).mean())
F=(-(down/vol) + 0.25*R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean()/vol).shift(1)
# reserve latest 10 observations to avoid incomplete forward labels
last=P.index.max(); cutoff=P.index[-11]
rows=[]
for dt in F.loc[:cutoff].index:
    y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
    q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',last.date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.loc[:cutoff].notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.loc[:cutoff].rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340622_downside_asymmetry_revalidation_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340622_downside_asymmetry_revalidation_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change()
v20=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); v120=R.rolling(120,min_periods=80).std()
# Buy assets whose recent volatility is unusually high relative to their own baseline, a mean-reversion test.
F=(v20/v120).shift(1)
cutoff=P.index[-11]; rows=[]
for dt in F.loc[:cutoff].index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A)); print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.loc[:cutoff].notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.loc[:cutoff].rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340622_volshock_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340622_volshock_reversal_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change(); vol=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std(); down=np.sqrt((R.clip(upper=0)**2).rolling(60,min_periods=20).mean())
F=(down/vol - .25*R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean()/vol).shift(1); cutoff=P.index[-11]; rows=[]
for dt in F.loc[:cutoff].index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A)); print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.loc[:cutoff].notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.loc[:cutoff].rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340622_downside_risk_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340622_downside_risk_reversal_signal.csv')

arguments.content:
import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-07-06']; R=P.pct_change(); vol=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std(); down=np.sqrt((R.clip(upper=0)**2).rolling(60,min_periods=20).mean())
F=(down/vol - .25*R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean()/vol).shift(1); rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A)); print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340706_downside_risk_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340706_downside_risk_reversal_signal.csv')

## Explored Factors

1. **Cross-asset lead-lag factor revalidation**
   - Construction: cross-asset lagged return/lead-lag relationship.
   - Motivation: identify instruments whose prior cross-market behavior predicts subsequent relative returns.
   - Result: ineffective over the full validation period.

2. **Volatility-shock reversal**
   - Construction: lagged ratio of 20-day volatility to 120-day volatility, \( \mathrm{vol}_{20}/\mathrm{vol}_{120} \).
   - Motivation: test whether unusually elevated recent volatility predicts mean reversion.
   - Result: ineffective over the full sample.

3. **Downside-risk reversal with risk-adjusted return correction**
   - Construction:  
     \[
     \mathrm{lag1}\left(
     \frac{\mathrm{downside\ RMS}_{60}}{\mathrm{volatility}_{60}}
     -0.25\frac{\mathrm{mean\ return}_{60}}{\mathrm{volatility}_{60}}
     \right)
     \]
   - Motivation: identify assets with relatively downside-heavy risk profiles while modestly correcting for recent risk-adjusted return.
   - Forward horizon: 10 trading days.
   - No future information was used; all signals were lagged by one completed session.

## Validation Results

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-07-19']; R=P.pct_change()
# Medium-horizon return penalized by downside risk; lagged to avoid lookahead.
down=np.sqrt((R.clip(upper=0)**2).rolling(60,min_periods=30).mean())
F=(P.pct_change(60)/down).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
rows=[]

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-07-19']; R=P.pct_change()
hi=P.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max(); lo=P.rolling(60,min_periods=40).min()
# Contrarian signal: assets near bottom of their trailing range receive higher score; lag one day.
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340720_range_position_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340720_range_position_reversal_signal.csv')

   - Forward horizon: 10 trading days.

   - Construction:
     \[
     -\frac{P_t-\min(P_{t-59:t})}
     {\max(P_{t-59:t})-\min(P_{t-59:t})}
     \]
     lagged by one completed session.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-08-02']; R=P.pct_change()
# Short-term oversold reversal, normalized by recent risk; lagged one completed day.
vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=12).std()
F=(-R.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum()/vol).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340803_shortterm_oversold_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340803_shortterm_oversold_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-08-16']
hi=P.rolling(80,min_periods=56).max(); lo=P.rolling(80,min_periods=56).min()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340817_range_position_80d_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340817_range_position_80d_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-08-30']
hi=P.rolling(100,min_periods=70).max(); lo=P.rolling(100,min_periods=70).min()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
    y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
    q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index()
# Equal blend of normalized range-position reversals, lagged one completed session.
parts=[]
for w in (40,80,120):
 hi=P.rolling(w,min_periods=int(w*.7)).max(); lo=P.rolling(w,min_periods=int(w*.7)).min()
 parts.append((-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan))
F=pd.concat(parts,keys=['40','80','120']).groupby(level=1).mean().shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340914_multihorizon_range_blend_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340914_multihorizon_range_blend_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-09-27']; R=P.pct_change()
# Contrarian signal: asset's recent 10-session return divergence from peer median,
# scaled by its 40-session realized volatility; all inputs lagged one session.
r10=R.rolling(10,min_periods=7).sum(); peer_med=r10.median(axis=1)
vol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(10)
F=(-(r10.sub(peer_med,axis=0))/vol).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340928_consensus_divergence_reversal_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340928_consensus_divergence_reversal_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-09-27']; R=P.pct_change()
# short-horizon idiosyncratic shock reversal, normalized by medium volatility
r5=R.rolling(5,min_periods=4).sum(); vol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(5)
F=(-r5/vol).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1;q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8:rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']);s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A));print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s)));print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4));os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True);r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340928_shock_reversal_ic.csv',index=False);F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340928_shock_reversal_signal.csv')

## Explored Factors

Validation date: **2034-09-28**

Universe: **15 tradable benchmark instruments**; daily IC observations required at least 8 valid instruments.

### 1. Consensus-divergence reversal

Construction:

\[
F_{i,t} =
-\frac{R_{i,t}^{(10)}-\operatorname{median}_j(R_{j,t}^{(10)})}
{\sigma_{i,t}^{(40)}\sqrt{10}}
\]

The signal buys assets that underperformed the cross-asset peer median over 10 sessions, scaled by 40-session volatility and lagged one session.

### 2. Volatility-scaled 20-day momentum

Construction:

\[
F_{i,t} =
\frac{R_{i,t}^{(20)}}{\sigma_{i,t}^{(40)}\sqrt{20}}
\]

The signal ranks assets by volatility-adjusted 20-session momentum, lagged one session.

### 3. Five-day shock reversal

Construction:

\[
F_{i,t} =
-\frac{R_{i,t}^{(5)}}{\sigma_{i,t}^{(40)}\sqrt{5}}
\]

The signal reverses recent five-session shocks using medium-term volatility normalization.

- Absolute daily paper ICIR must be at least **0.0840**

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-10-11']
r20=P.pct_change(20); disp=r20.std(axis=1).rolling(60,min_periods=30).rank(pct=True)
lo=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).min(); hi=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).max()
base=-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)
F=(base*(0.5+disp)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341012_dispersion_range_revalidation_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341012_dispersion_range_revalidation_signal.csv')

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-09-13']
parts=[]
for w in (40,80,120):
 hi=P.rolling(w,min_periods=int(w*.7)).max(); lo=P.rolling(w,min_periods=int(w*.7)).min()
 parts.append((-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan))
F=pd.concat(parts,keys=['40','80','120']).groupby(level=1).mean().shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20340914_multihorizon_range_blend_ic.csv',index=False)

Revalidated the existing cross-asset range-reversal concept with a market-dispersion condition:

\[
F_{i,t} =
-\frac{P_{i,t}-\min(P_{i,t-59:t})}
{\max(P_{i,t-59:t})-\min(P_{i,t-59:t})}
\left(0.5+\text{PercentileRank}_{60}
\left[\sigma_{\text{cross-section}}(R^{20})\right]\right)
\]

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-10-25']
r=P.pct_change(20)
# Relative strength versus contemporaneous cross-sectional median, volatility-scaled.
rel=r.sub(r.median(axis=1),axis=0)
vol=P.pct_change().rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
F=(rel/vol.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341026_market_relative_momentum_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341026_market_relative_momentum_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-10-25']
# Short-horizon oversold reversal, normalized by recent volatility and lagged.
r5=P.pct_change(5); vol20=P.pct_change().rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
F=(-r5/vol20.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341026_short_reversal_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341026_short_reversal_signal.csv')

from scipy.stats import spearmanr

P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-10-11']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1); mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max(); disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
lo=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).min(); hi=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).max()
base=-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)
F=base.mul(0.5+disp, axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1
 q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r['date'].min().date(),r['date'].max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:

print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True)
r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341012_dispersion_range_revalidation_ic.csv',index=False)
F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341012_dispersion_range_revalidation_signal.csv')
"}

## Explored Factors

1. **Revalidated dispersion-conditioned 60-day range reversal**
   - Construction: Contrarian position within each asset’s trailing 60-day price range, multiplied by a cross-asset 20-day return-dispersion percentile.
   - Signal lag: one completed session.
   - Forward horizon: 10 trading days.
   - Motivation: range-bound assets near trailing lows may mean-revert more strongly during elevated cross-asset dispersion.

2. **VIX-conditioned 20-day reversal**
   - Construction: negative 20-day return, scaled by the trailing 120-day VIX percentile.
   - Signal lag: one completed session.
   - Forward horizon: 10 trading days.
   - Motivation: test whether reversal is stronger during elevated volatility regimes.

## Validation Results

Validation date: **2034-11-09**  
Price data available through: **2034-11-08**

| VIX-conditioned 20d reversal | 2,765 | 14.63 | 0.017050 | 0.051070 | 77.50% | 0.0885 | Failed |

The range-reversal factor passed the benchmark admission gates of absolute daily paper IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute daily paper ICIR ≥ 0.0840.

- 120 observations: IC 0.025161, ICIR 0.075987
- 260 observations: IC 0.022144, ICIR 0.066253
- 520 observations: IC 0.019050, ICIR 0.059942
- 780 observations: IC 0.040860, ICIR 0.124191

The VIX-conditioned reversal failed the ICIR gate despite positive full-history IC. Its recent 260-observation ICIR was strong at 0.225432, but this was not sufficient to qualify it on the full validation sample.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-11-22']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1); mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean()
lo=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).min(); hi=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341123_smoothed_dispersion_range_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341123_smoothed_dispersion_range_reversal_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-12-06']; r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1)
mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean()
lo=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).min(); hi=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341207_dispersion_range_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341207_dispersion_range_reversal_signal.csv')

{"read_file": "import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-11-22']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1); mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean()
lo=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).min(); hi=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-12-20']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1)
mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean()
lo=P.rolling(90,min_periods=63).min(); hi=P.rolling(90,min_periods=63).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341221_dispersion_range_reversal_90d_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341221_dispersion_range_reversal_90d_signal.csv')

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2034-12-06']; r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1)
mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean()
lo=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).min(); hi=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341207_dispersion_range_reversal_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20341207_dispersion_range_reversal_signal.csv')
"}

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2035-01-03']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1)
mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean()
lo=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).min(); hi=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350104_dispersion_range_reversal_60d_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350104_dispersion_range_reversal_60d_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2035-01-17']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1)
mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
lo=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).min(); hi=P.rolling(60,min_periods=42).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350118_dispersion_range_reversal_60d_smooth10_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350118_dispersion_range_reversal_60d_smooth10_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2035-01-31']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1); mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
lo=P.rolling(120,min_periods=84).min(); hi=P.rolling(120,min_periods=84).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350201_dispersion_range_reversal_120d_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350201_dispersion_range_reversal_120d_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2035-02-14']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1); mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
lo=P.rolling(120,min_periods=84).min(); hi=P.rolling(120,min_periods=84).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350215_dispersion_range_reversal_120d_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350215_dispersion_range_reversal_120d_signal.csv')

{"read_file": "import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2035-01-31']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1); mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
lo=P.rolling(120,min_periods=84).min(); hi=P.rolling(120,min_periods=84).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2035-02-28']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1); mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
lo=P.rolling(180,min_periods=126).min(); hi=P.rolling(180,min_periods=126).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350301_dispersion_range_reversal_180d_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350301_dispersion_range_reversal_180d_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2035-03-14']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1); mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
lo=P.rolling(180,min_periods=126).min(); hi=P.rolling(180,min_periods=126).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350315_dispersion_range_reversal_180d_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350315_dispersion_range_reversal_180d_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2035-03-28']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1); mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max(); disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
lo=P.rolling(210,min_periods=147).min(); hi=P.rolling(210,min_periods=147).max(); F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A)); print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4)); os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350329_dispersion_range_reversal_210d_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350329_dispersion_range_reversal_210d_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float) for a in A}
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().loc[:'2035-04-11']
r20=P.pct_change(20); ds=r20.std(axis=1)
mn=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).min(); mx=ds.rolling(60,min_periods=30).max()
disp=((ds-mn)/(mx-mn)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean()
lo=P.rolling(240,min_periods=168).min(); hi=P.rolling(240,min_periods=168).max()
F=(-(P-lo)/(hi-lo)).mul(0.5+disp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in F.index:
 y=P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1; q=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],y],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(q),spearmanr(q.iloc[:,0],q.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']); s=r.ic
print('data_last',P.index.max().date(),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'dates',len(r),'avgN',round(r.n.mean(),2),'assets',len(A))
print('IC',round(s.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(s.mean()/s.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((s>0).mean(),4))
for k in [120,260,520,780]:
 q=s.tail(min(k,len(s))); print('recent',k,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('coverage',round(F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(A),4),'rank_turnover',round(F.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),4))
os.makedirs('scripts/artifacts',exist_ok=True); r.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350412_dispersion_range_reversal_240d_ic.csv',index=False); F.to_csv('scripts/artifacts/miner_3_20350412_dispersion_range_reversal_240d_signal.csv')
